005package org.wpilib.tunable;
006
007import java.util.Objects;
008import java.util.function.Consumer;
009import java.util.function.Supplier;

015/**
016 * A tunable value.
017 *
018 * @param <T> value class
019 */
020public abstract class Tunable<T> extends TunableBase implements Supplier<T>, Consumer<T> {
021  private static final String UNSUPPORTED_TUNABLE_TYPE = "Unsupported tunable type: ";
022
023  /**
024   * A tunable value serialized with a {@link Struct}.
025   *
026   * @param <T> value type
027   */
028  public static class TunableStruct<T> extends Tunable<T> {
029    TunableStruct(T initialValue, Struct<T> struct, TunableConfig config) {
030      super(config, true);
031      m_struct = struct;
032      m_value = initialValue;
033    }
034
035    @Override
036    public void set(T value) {
037      m_value = value;
038      markChanged();
039    }
040
041    @Override
042    public T get() {
043      return m_value;
044    }
045
046    @Override
047    public Class<T> getTypeClass() {
048      return m_struct.getTypeClass();
049    }
050
051    /**
052     * Gets the struct serializer.
053     *
054     * @return struct serializer
055     */
056    public Struct<T> getStruct() {
057      return m_struct;
058    }
059
060    private final Struct<T> m_struct;
061    private T m_value;
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * A tunable array of values serialized with a {@link Struct}.
066   *
067   * @param <T> array element type
068   */
069  public static class TunableStructArray<T> extends Tunable<T[]> {
070    TunableStructArray(T[] initialValue, Struct<T> struct, Class<T[]> cls, TunableConfig config) {
071      super(config, true);
072      m_struct = struct;
073      m_cls = cls;
074      m_value = initialValue == null ? null : initialValue.clone();
075    }
076
077    @Override
078    public void set(T[] value) {
079      m_value = value == null ? null : value.clone();
080      markChanged();
081    }
082
083    @Override
084    public T[] get() {
085      return m_value == null ? null : m_value.clone();
086    }
087
088    @Override
089    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.MethodReturnsInternalArray")
090    public T[] mutate() {
091      markChanged();
092      return m_value;
093    }
094
095    @Override
096    public Class<T[]> getTypeClass() {
097      return m_cls;
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * Gets the struct serializer.
102     *
103     * @return struct serializer
104     */
105    public Struct<T> getStruct() {
106      return m_struct;
107    }
108
109    private final Struct<T> m_struct;
110    private final Class<T[]> m_cls;
111    private T[] m_value;
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * A tunable value serialized with a {@link Protobuf}.
116   *
117   * @param <T> value type
118   */
119  public static class TunableProtobuf<T> extends Tunable<T> {
120    TunableProtobuf(T initialValue, Protobuf<T, ?> proto, TunableConfig config) {
121      super(config, true);
122      m_proto = proto;
123      m_value = initialValue;
124    }
125
126    @Override
127    public void set(T value) {
128      m_value = value;
129      markChanged();
130    }
131
132    @Override
133    public T get() {
134      return m_value;
135    }
136
137    @Override
138    public Class<T> getTypeClass() {
139      return m_proto.getTypeClass();
140    }
141
142    /**
143     * Gets the protobuf serializer.
144     *
145     * @return protobuf serializer
146     */
147    public Protobuf<T, ?> getProtobuf() {
148      return m_proto;
149    }
150
151    private final Protobuf<T, ?> m_proto;
152    private T m_value;
153  }
154
155  private abstract static class BasicTunable<T> extends Tunable<T> {
156    BasicTunable(Class<T> cls, TunableConfig config) {
157      super(config, true);
158      m_cls = cls;
159    }
160
161    @Override
162    public Class<T> getTypeClass() {
163      return m_cls;
164    }
165
166    private final Class<T> m_cls;
167  }
168
169  /** A wrapper that exposes an inner tunable implementation. */
170  @FunctionalInterface
171  public interface CustomTunable {
172    /**
173     * Gets the inner tunable.
174     *
175     * @return inner tunable
176     */
177    TunableBase getInnerTunable();
178  }
179
180  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
181  private static <T> Class<T> getValueClass(T value) {
182    return (Class<T>) value.getClass();
183  }
184
185  private static boolean isSupportedBasicType(Class<?> cls) {
186    return cls == Boolean.class
187        || cls == Integer.class
188        || cls == Long.class
189        || cls == Float.class
190        || cls == Double.class
191        || cls == String.class
192        || cls == byte[].class
193        || cls == boolean[].class
194        || cls == int[].class
195        || cls == long[].class
196        || cls == float[].class
197        || cls == double[].class
198        || cls == String[].class;
199  }
200
201  private static String getTypeName(Class<?> cls) {
202    return cls == null ? "<null>" : cls.getName();
203  }
204
205  private static void warnIfUnsupportedBasicType(Class<?> cls) {
206    if (!isSupportedBasicType(cls)) {
207      TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
208          UNSUPPORTED_TUNABLE_TYPE + getTypeName(cls) + "; it may not be published by backends");
209    }
210  }
211
212  private static void warnIfUnpublishableTunable(TunableBase tunable) {
213    if (tunable == null) {
214      return;
215    }
216    if (tunable instanceof CustomTunable custom) {
217      warnIfUnpublishableTunable(custom.getInnerTunable());
218    } else if (tunable instanceof TunableBoolean
219        || tunable instanceof TunableInt
220        || tunable instanceof TunableLong
221        || tunable instanceof TunableFloat
222        || tunable instanceof TunableDouble
223        || tunable instanceof TunableStruct<?>
224        || tunable instanceof TunableStructArray<?>
225        || tunable instanceof TunableProtobuf<?>) {
226      return;
227    } else if (tunable instanceof Tunable<?> generic) {
228      warnIfUnsupportedBasicType(generic.getTypeClass());
229    } else {
230      TunableRegistry.reportWarning(UNSUPPORTED_TUNABLE_TYPE + tunable.getClass().getName());
231    }
232  }
233
234  private static <T> Tunable<T> createBasic(T initialValue, TunableConfig config) {
235    return createBasic(initialValue, getValueClass(initialValue), config);
236  }
237
238  private static <T> Tunable<T> createBasic(T initialValue, Class<T> cls, TunableConfig config) {
239    warnIfUnsupportedBasicType(cls);
240    return new BasicTunable<T>(cls, config) {
241      @Override
242      public void set(T value) {
243        m_value = value;
244        markChanged();
245      }
246
247      @Override
248      public T get() {
249        return m_value;
250      }
251
252      private T m_value = initialValue;
253    };
254  }
255
256  private static <T> Struct<T> getStruct(Class<T> cls) {
257    Struct<?> struct = getStructObject(cls);
258    if (struct == null) {
259      return null;
260    }
261    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
262    Struct<T> typedStruct = (Struct<T>) struct;
263    return typedStruct;
264  }
265
266  private static Struct<?> getStructObject(Class<?> cls) {
267    // use introspection to get "struct" static variable
268    Object obj;
269    try {
270      obj = cls.getField("struct").get(null);
271    } catch (NoSuchFieldException e) {
272      TunableRegistry.reportWarning("could not get struct field for " + cls.getName());
273      return null;
274    } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
275      TunableRegistry.reportWarning("could not access struct field for " + cls.getName());
276      return null;
277    }
278    switch (obj) {
279      case Struct<?> s when s.getTypeClass().equals(cls) -> {
280        return s;
281      }
282      case Struct<?> s ->
283          TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
284              "type mismatch, expected '"
285                  + s.getTypeClass().getName()
286                  + "', got '"
287                  + cls.getName()
288                  + "'");
289      default ->
290          TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
291              "struct field for " + cls.getName() + " is not of Struct<?> type");
292    }
293    return null;
294  }
295
296  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
297  private static <T> Tunable<T> createStructArrayTunable(
298      T initialValue, Class<T> cls, Struct<?> struct, TunableConfig config) {
299    return (Tunable<T>)
300        new TunableStructArray<>(
301            (Object[]) initialValue, (Struct<Object>) struct, (Class<Object[]>) cls, config);
302  }
303
304  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
305  private static <T> Tunable<T> createGetterSetterStructArrayTunable(
306      Supplier<T> getter,
307      Consumer<T> setter,
308      Class<T> cls,
309      Struct<?> struct,
310      TunableConfig config) {
311    return (Tunable<T>)
312        new TunableStructArray<>(null, (Struct<Object>) struct, (Class<Object[]>) cls, config) {
313          @Override
314          public void set(Object[] value) {
315            if (setter != null) {
316              setter.accept((T) value);
317            }
318            markChanged();
319          }
320
321          @Override
322          public Object[] get() {
323            return (Object[]) getter.get();
324          }
325
326          @Override
327          public Object[] mutate() {
328            markChanged();
329            return get();
330          }
331        };
332  }
333
334  private static <T> Protobuf<T, ?> getProtobuf(Class<T> cls) {
335    // use introspection to get "proto" static variable
336    Object obj;
337    try {
338      obj = cls.getField("proto").get(null);
339    } catch (NoSuchFieldException e) {
340      TunableRegistry.reportWarning("could not get proto field for " + cls.getName());
341      return null;
342    } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
343      TunableRegistry.reportWarning("could not access proto field for " + cls.getName());
344      return null;
345    }
346    switch (obj) {
347      case Protobuf<?, ?> s when s.getTypeClass().equals(cls) -> {
348        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
349        Protobuf<T, ?> proto = (Protobuf<T, ?>) s;
350        return proto;
351      }
352      case Protobuf<?, ?> s ->
353          TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
354              "type mismatch, expected '"
355                  + s.getTypeClass().getName()
356                  + "', got '"
357                  + cls.getName()
358                  + "'");
359      default ->
360          TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
361              "proto field for " + cls.getName() + " is not of Protobuf<?, ?> type");
362    }
363    return null;
364  }
365
366  private static <T> Tunable<T> createGetterSetterTunable(
367      Supplier<T> getter, Consumer<T> setter, Struct<T> struct, TunableConfig config) {
368    return new TunableStruct<T>(null, struct, config) {
369      @Override
370      public void set(T value) {
371        if (setter != null) {
372          setter.accept(value);
373        }
374        markChanged();
375      }
376
377      @Override
378      public T get() {
379        return getter.get();
380      }
381    };
382  }
383
384  private static <T> Tunable<T> createGetterSetterTunable(
385      Supplier<T> getter, Consumer<T> setter, Protobuf<T, ?> proto, TunableConfig config) {
386    return new TunableProtobuf<T>(null, proto, config) {
387      @Override
388      public void set(T value) {
389        if (setter != null) {
390          setter.accept(value);
391        }
392        markChanged();
393      }
394
395      @Override
396      public T get() {
397        return getter.get();
398      }
399    };
400  }

406   * @param cls class of the tunable type

414   * Creates a tunable object with the given config and a null initial value.

418   * @param config tunable config

425  /**
426   * Creates a tunable object with the given initial value.
427   *
428   * @param <T> data type
429   * @param initialValue the initial value
430   * @return Tunable
431   */
432  public static <T> Tunable<T> create(T initialValue) {
433    return createConfig(initialValue, null);
434  }
435
436  /**
437   * Creates a tunable object with a specific Struct serializer.
438   *
439   * @param <T> data type
440   * @param initialValue the initial value
441   * @param struct struct serializer
442   * @return Tunable
443   */
444  public static <T> Tunable<T> create(T initialValue, Struct<T> struct) {
445    Objects.requireNonNull(struct);
446    return createConfig(initialValue, struct, null);

449  /**
450   * Creates a tunable object with a specific Protobuf serializer.
451   *
452   * @param <T> data type
453   * @param initialValue the initial value
454   * @param proto protobuf serializer
455   * @return Tunable
456   */
457  public static <T> Tunable<T> create(T initialValue, Protobuf<T, ?> proto) {
458    Objects.requireNonNull(proto);
459    return createConfig(initialValue, proto, null);
460  }
461
462  /**
463   * Creates a tunable object with the given getter and setter.
464   *
465   * <p>The getter and setter must not throw.
466   *
467   * @param <T> data type
468   * @param getter getter for the tunable value
469   * @param setter setter for the tunable value
470   * @param cls class of the tunable type
471   * @return Tunable
472   */
473  public static <T> Tunable<T> create(Supplier<T> getter, Consumer<T> setter, Class<T> cls) {
474    return createConfig(getter, setter, cls, null);
475  }
476
477  /**
478   * Creates a tunable object with the given config and initial value.
479   *
480   * @param <T> data type
481   * @param initialValue the initial value
482   * @param config tunable config
483   * @return Tunable
484   */
485  public static <T> Tunable<T> createConfig(T initialValue, TunableConfig config) {
486    Objects.requireNonNull(initialValue);
487    Class<T> cls = getValueClass(initialValue);
488    if (initialValue instanceof StructSerializable) {
489      Struct<T> struct = getStruct(cls);
490      if (struct != null) {
491        return createConfig(initialValue, struct, config);
492      }
493    } else if (cls.isArray() && StructSerializable.class.isAssignableFrom(cls.getComponentType())) {
494      Struct<?> struct = getStructObject(cls.getComponentType());
495      if (struct != null) {
496        return createStructArrayTunable(initialValue, cls, struct, config);
497      }
498    } else if (initialValue instanceof ProtobufSerializable) {
499      Protobuf<T, ?> proto = getProtobuf(cls);
500      if (proto != null) {
501        return createConfig(initialValue, proto, config);
502      }
503    } else {
504      // try other handlers
505      var handler = TunableRegistry.getTypeHandler(initialValue);
506      if (handler != null) {
507        Tunable<T> tunable = handler.createTunable(initialValue, config);
508        if (tunable != null) {
509          warnIfUnpublishableTunable(tunable);
510          return tunable;
511        }
512      }
513    }
514    return createBasic(initialValue, config);
515  }
516
517  /**
518   * Creates a tunable object with a specific Struct serializer.
519   *
520   * @param <T> data type
521   * @param initialValue the initial value (may be null)
522   * @param struct struct serializer
523   * @param config tunable config
524   * @return Tunable
525   */
526  public static <T> Tunable<T> createConfig(
527      T initialValue, Struct<T> struct, TunableConfig config) {
528    return new TunableStruct<T>(initialValue, struct, config);
529  }
530
531  /**
532   * Creates a tunable object with a specific Protobuf serializer.
533   *
534   * @param <T> data type
535   * @param initialValue the initial value (may be null)
536   * @param proto protobuf serializer
537   * @param config tunable config
538   * @return Tunable
539   */
540  public static <T> Tunable<T> createConfig(
541      T initialValue, Protobuf<T, ?> proto, TunableConfig config) {
542    return new TunableProtobuf<T>(initialValue, proto, config);
543  }
544
545  /**
546   * Creates a tunable object with the given getter and setter and config.
547   *
548   * <p>The getter and setter must not throw.
549   *
550   * @param <T> data type
551   * @param getter getter for the tunable value
552   * @param setter setter for the tunable value
553   * @param cls class of the tunable type
554   * @param config tunable config
555   * @return Tunable
556   */
557  public static <T> Tunable<T> createConfig(
558      Supplier<T> getter, Consumer<T> setter, Class<T> cls, TunableConfig config) {
559    if (config == null) {
560      config = TunableConfig.of(TunableOption.ALWAYS_GET);
561    } else if (config.getPolling() == TunableConfig.Polling.DEFAULT) {
562      config = config.withPolling(TunableConfig.Polling.ALWAYS_GET);
563    }
564    if (cls != null && StructSerializable.class.isAssignableFrom(cls)) {
565      Struct<T> struct = getStruct(cls);
566      if (struct != null) {
567        return createGetterSetterTunable(getter, setter, struct, config);
568      }
569    } else if (cls != null
570        && cls.isArray()
571        && StructSerializable.class.isAssignableFrom(cls.getComponentType())) {
572      Struct<?> struct = getStructObject(cls.getComponentType());
573      if (struct != null) {
574        return createGetterSetterStructArrayTunable(getter, setter, cls, struct, config);
575      }
576    } else if (cls != null && ProtobufSerializable.class.isAssignableFrom(cls)) {
577      Protobuf<T, ?> proto = getProtobuf(cls);
578      if (proto != null) {
579        return createGetterSetterTunable(getter, setter, proto, config);
580      }
581    }
582    warnIfUnsupportedBasicType(cls);
583    return new BasicTunable<T>(cls, config) {
584      @Override
585      public void set(T value) {
586        if (setter != null) {
587          setter.accept(value);
588        }
589        markChanged();
590      }
591
592      @Override
593      public T get() {
594        return getter.get();
595      }
596    };
597  }
598
599  /**
600   * Constructs a tunable.
601   *
602   * @param config tunable config
603   */
604  protected Tunable(TunableConfig config) {
605    super(config);
606  }
607
608  /**
609   * Constructs a tunable.
610   *
611   * @param config tunable config
612   * @param supportsChangeNotification whether the tunable notifies backends when it changes
613   */
614  protected Tunable(TunableConfig config, boolean supportsChangeNotification) {
615    super(config, supportsChangeNotification);
616  }
617
618  /**
619   * Sets the value.
620   *
621   * <p>Implementations must not throw.
622   *
623   * @param value value
624   */
625  public abstract void set(T value);
626
627  /**
628   * Gets the value.
629   *
630   * <p>Implementations must not throw.
631   *
632   * @return value
633   */
634  @Override
635  public abstract T get();
636
637  /**
638   * Gets the value for in-place mutation and marks this tunable changed.
639   *
640   * <p>This is useful for mutable structured/protobuf values where modifying the object returned by
641   * {@link #get()} would otherwise bypass {@link #set(Object)} and not notify backends. For
642   * immutable values, prefer {@link #set(Object)}. For variable-length arrays, use {@link
643   * #set(Object)} with a new array to change the length.
644   *
645   * @return mutable value
646   */
647  public T mutate() {
648    markChanged();
649    return get();
650  }
651
652  @Override
653  public void accept(T value) {
654    set(value);
655  }
656
657  /**
658   * Gets the class of the tunable type. This is used for determining which type handler to use.
659   *
660   * @return class of the tunable type
661   */
662  public abstract Class<T> getTypeClass();
663}
